## Notable Production Projects & Case Studies

### 1. PromptForge — AI Prompt Engineering Platform
- **URL**: https://promtforge-seven.vercel.app/
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, OpenRouter API.
- **Description**: Precision developer platform for structuring, optimizing, and discovering production-ready AI directives across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini workflows. Features a 6-pillar prompt optimizer with negative constraint evaluation.

### 2. SV Music — High-Fidelity Android Music Player
- **Releases**: https://github.com/suman-verse/sv-music/releases/tag/v1
- **Stack**: Android, Kotlin, ExoPlayer, Material You, Offline Audio Cache.
- **Description**: Minimalist high-fidelity music streaming & offline playback application featuring Time Machine listening telemetry, background audio service, and OLED true-black battery saver mode.

### 3. Desun Hospital — Healthcare Web Portal
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs.
- **Description**: Digital portal for NABH & JCI accredited superspeciality hospital. Features dual doctor & department search, real-time OPD consultation booking, robotic surgery showcase, and emergency hotline. Reduced appointment queue times by 40%.

### 4. Aero Force — Tebex Webstore Gaming Template
- **Stack**: React 19, Tebex REST API, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Glassmorphism.
- **Description**: Ultra-responsive dark-mode webstore template for Minecraft and FiveM server networks. Powered 14,200+ completed store orders across 25,000+ active players with average page load under 1.1s.

### 5. OneTag Athletes — Custom Jersey E-Commerce
- **Stack**: WordPress, WooCommerce, Custom Name/Number Heat Pressing, Razorpay UPI.
- **Description**: Athletic e-commerce platform with live jersey personalization, custom team discount tiers, and pan-India express order tracking. Over 50,000+ custom jerseys printed.

### 6. BLUEBZ — Floral Preservation & Resin Studio
- **Stack**: React 19, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas API, Web Audio API.
- **Description**: Museum-grade luxury editorial website with interactive fresh-vs-preserved split-screen slider and ambient soundscapes. Achieved 94% reservation conversion rate.

### 7. Nebula Guard — Security & Threat Dashboard
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, SVG Gauges.
- **Description**: Real-time cybersecurity telemetry dashboard featuring 0-1000 risk score gauges, virus breakdown rings, and live device logs. Accelerated SecOps response by 48%.

### 8. Wardex Studio — AI YouTube Thumbnail Editor
- **Stack**: React 19, HTML5 Canvas API, WebGL shaders, WebAssembly AI cutouts.
- **Description**: Browser-native 4K thumbnail editor with automatic AI subject cutouts and outline effects used by 150,000+ creators.
